Package frc.robot.utils.targeting

Record Class ShotSolution

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
frc.robot.utils.targeting.ShotSolution
Record Components:
hoodDeg - hood angle in degrees from vertical (0 = straight up)
rpm - flywheel speed
timeOfFlightS - time from leaving the shooter to reaching the target
inRange - whether the solver trusts this solution (inside its data or limits)
source - which solver produced it
public record ShotSolution(double hoodDeg, double rpm, double timeOfFlightS, boolean inRange, ShotSolution.Source source) extends Record
Hood angle, flywheel speed and flight time for a shot from a stationary robot at a given horizontal distance. The ShotPlanner handles robot motion and aiming; a solution only describes the shot itself.
